caption_L1: Total number of participants in lacrosse in the United States from 2001 to 2018 is a line chart. The y-axis plots Number of participants using linear scale of range 0 to 800,000 while the x-axis shows Year on linear scale from 2005 to 2015.
caption_L2L3: The graph shows an increase from 250,000 lacrosse players in 2001, increasing year on year with a slight plateau between 2017 and 2018 showing there were approximately 810,000 lacrosse players in those years.
